title: Mors Drink
html:
Quest Giver: Khodebshchik

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Go to side areas off of the 5th and 7th levels of Ratsputin's Gulag. Find and kill Volcanic Gushers for 20 Fire Eyes and kill Shadowspawn Knights or Dark Angels for 20 bags of Shadow Spice. Return to Khodebshchik in Ratsputin's Holding Cell when completed.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Khodebshchik

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Go to side areas off of the 5th and 7th levels of Ratsputin's Gulag. Find and kill Volcanic Gushers for 20 Fire Eyes and kill Shadowspawn Knights or Dark Angels for 20 bags of Shadow Spice. Return to Khodebshchik in Ratsputin's Holding Cell when completed.

Offer:

You need Mors more from me? I mean more Mors? What if I just say, Do you need Mores? I'm just trying to cut corners in conversation, so I don't have to cut corners in drink crafting. Bring Khodebshchik twenty Fire Eyes and twenty bags of Shadow Spice to Ratsputin's Holding Cell and I will make you Mores.

Turn-in:

One finely crafted container of Mors. I know I keep asking this, but are you sure this is just for you? You wouldn't happen to be cutting into my sales now would you?

Objectives:

  • Fire Eyes ×20
  • Shadow Spice ×20

Client level range: 75–95
